messages.subject: CEO: Traversence vs Wix and Squarespace (costs vs benefits)
messages.body:
The 5-page PDF is in the CEO chat (download it there to review with Gemini). Bottom line:
1) Price. Core is $79.95/mo. Wix's commerce plans are $29–$159/mo billed yearly; Squarespace's are $19–$99/mo. Card processing is about the same everywhere (~2.9% + 30¢). Only Squarespace Basic adds a 2% platform fee. Core costs about $51/mo more than Wix Core or Squarespace Core at any sales volume.
2) Only we have: a place in the regional directory and guides (never paid ranking), GO Codes and short links, zero commission, manual payments on every plan, and local support.
3) They're stronger today: mature site builders and templates, app markets, abandoned-cart and email campaigns, bigger product limits (ours is 100 items on Core), and payments and domains that work now.
4) Our gaps before Core can sell e-commerce: card checkout and domains are built but not live (sandbox keys, domains in test mode); Core's 500 emails and campaigns aren't built; the site is still closed to search engines, so the local-traffic benefit can't be shown yet.
5) Suggestions in the PDF (not decided): turn on live payments and domains first; a first-year domain credit on yearly Core; revisit Core's item cap; measure each listing's referral traffic once the search lock lifts.
Competitor figures came from each company's own site through search results; confirm them on their pricing pages before deciding.
